stem: Grace wants to end her paper with a quotation from Bindi Irwin. Which of these quotations could follow sentence 21 and most effectively close this paper?

options.label: F
options.text: "It's interesting," notes Bindi. "I really don't look at myself as famous."

options.label: G
options.text: "I don't want to grow up in a world without wildlife," insists Bindi. "My daddy was a wildlife warrior, and I'm going to continue his work."

options.label: H
options.text: "It's nice to be able to talk to people and share your ways of dealing with things," says Bindi.

options.label: J
options.text: "We're always working with the government and different organizations and just working at it slowly," explains Bindi.
